STEP 1 - Scene: A bowl of fresh mixed berries (strawberries, blackberries, blueberries), no other foods visible. Photographed from above, nearly top-down, with the square white plate filling most of the frame.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square plate, roughly 26 cm across at its widest edge. Area ≈ 26 x 26 x ~0.85 (rounded corners) ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Strawberries (halved and whole pieces)
- Blackberries
- Blueberries

STEP 4 - Area (share of plate covered):
- Strawberries ~14% (≈75 cm²)
- Blackberries ~6% (≈32 cm²)
- Blueberries ~4% (≈21 cm²)
Total food coverage ≈ 24% of the plate, which is sparse, consistent with the scattered pile.

STEP 5 - Volume (outer envelope, heights estimated from pile thickness):
- Strawberries: 75 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 112 ml
- Blackberries: 32 cm² x 1.5 cm ≈ 48 ml
- Blueberries: 21 cm² x 1.0 cm ≈ 21 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density for fruit pieces ~0.6 g/ml):
- Strawberries: 112 x 0.6 ≈ 67 g
- Blackberries: 48 x 0.6 ≈ 29 g
- Blueberries: 21 x 0.6 ≈ 13 g
Total ≈ 109 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Strawberries: 67 g x 32 kcal/100g ≈ 21 kcal
- Blackberries: 29 g x 43 kcal/100g ≈ 12 kcal
- Blueberries: 13 g x 57 kcal/100g ≈ 7 kcal
Total ≈ 40 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 110 g of scattered berries on a large plate is plausible. Forty kcal fits a light fruit portion. The pile is sparse, not a full serving, so the estimate stays small.

Estimated total: about 110 g, about 40 kcal.
